newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA, TIETO IN NEW TECH INDEX.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA, TIETO IN NEW TECH INDEX.

text.p: Shares of two Finnish firms; telecoms group Nokia Oy and data systems group TT Tieto Oy, are components of a new EuroTec index launched on Monday by Morgan Stanley, the U.S. investment bank said in a statement.
"The index has been designed to satisfy a demand in the investment marketplace for a European technology index and a liquid technology investment index," Morgan Stanley said.
The index comprises 20 technology companies ranging from computer services to semiconductor capital equipment, it said.
Other Nordic companies in the index are Sweden's Ericsson and WM-Data.
Morgan Stanley said its EuroTec index had risen 88 percent since June 21, 1996 compared to a 54 percent rise for its own Morgan Stanley High Tech-35 index (MSH) comprised of U.S. technology stocks.

"Based on this performance and the increasing interest that the sector is attracting, discussions are under way to launch listed derivative products on the back of the EuroTec index," Morgan Stanley said.
